Hi HeliumDeploy team,

HeliumDeploy ships out of the Montreal area, which opens up carrier options most of Canada cannot get.

We have preferred pricing with Intelcom, Amazon's preferred carrier, often 50% or more below UPS and Purolator on the same parcels.

Send one invoice and I will price it against what you pay now. No cost either way.

Worth a look?

Sara N.
